records.name: Philadelphia Veterans Parade and Festival
records.summary: A yearly parade and street festival on the Ben Franklin Parkway that honors veterans. Veterans started it about 12 years ago, and bands, groups and organizations can apply to march in it or run a table at the festival.
records.what_you_do: Groups march in the parade or staff a festival table. Anyone can come watch the parade and visit the festival.

schedule.text: Parade starts at noon on Sunday, November 8, 2026, on the Ben Franklin Parkway and ends at the Eakins Oval festival

locations.label: Ben Franklin Parkway to Eakins Oval

cost.text: The parade site does not list a fee for watching. It does not state a fee for marching either.

first_step.how: Apply online through the parade's application form, linked from the parade website. Approved groups get staging details from a separate page.
first_step.basis: Watching is open to anyone and groups can apply through a posted online form, though approval is not guaranteed.

records.notes: Also called the Philadelphia Veterans Day Parade. The site lists 2026 grand marshal and sponsors, and posts run to October 2, 2026. The site names no phone or email, only an About/Contact page and Facebook and Instagram. The 2026 application form (form.jotform.com) was seen only in search results, not opened. Search snippets said fees are waived for nonprofits, community organizations and veterans service groups, but this was not confirmed on the parade's own pages, so cost is left unknown.

leads_only.name: Rail Park friends group (The Rail Park)
leads_only.note: Checked, but it is a park care group, not a tradition. Its site lists volunteer clean-ups on Oct 14 and Oct 21, 2026, and a contact at friends@therailpark.org. No 2026 block party is listed. Handed to the nature-environment lane to write the record.

leads_only.name: Odunde Festival (Odunde Inc.)
leads_only.note: Site returned HTTP 503 on two tries (home page and volunteer page). Press coverage describes a volunteer staff of more than 200 people and a second Sunday of June festival. Retry needed before a record can be written.

leads_only.name: Greek Independence Day Parade, Philadelphia (Federation of Hellenic American Societies of Philadelphia)
leads_only.note: National Herald article lists a 2026 Philadelphia parade order, but that article returned HTTP 403. The Philadelphia federation's own site was not found. The hellenicsocieties.org site found in search belongs to the Federation of Hellenic Societies of Greater New York (Astoria office, 5th Avenue parade), so it was NOT used for this record.

leads_only.name: Manayunk Development Corporation (festival organizer)
leads_only.note: Dropped as a record: the events page lists 2026 festivals by month only, with no volunteer call and no dated 2026 notice on its own pages. Festival dates for 2026 came only from vendor sites. Contact on the page: info@manayunk.org, 215-482-9565. Could be re-checked later if a volunteer call appears.

leads_only.name: Concilio (organizer of the Puerto Rican Day Parade, Philadelphia)
leads_only.note: Domain now redirects to a parked for-sale page, so the group's own site cannot be read. Search results name Concilio as the organizer. Needs a new official link before a record.

leads_only.name: Pulaski Day Parade, Philadelphia
leads_only.note: Search turned up only older Philadelphia coverage (last found: October 2024). The pulaskiparade.org site found is the New York City committee, so it was not used. No 2026 Philadelphia parade info found.

leads_only.name: Philly Pride 365 (Pride march)
leads_only.note: Checked the homepage. It is a year-round LGBTQIA+ civic group that runs a march and OURfest, with volunteer and vendor links. No 2026 march date or line-up application is on the homepage, so no record. Search snippets mention a June 7, 2026 march and a $25 group application, but these came from other pages not opened. Best handed to the lgbtq lane.

leads_only.name: 250th Salute to Independence Parade (City of Philadelphia with Wawa Welcome America)
leads_only.note: City-run event for July 3, 2026, not a community group. Bands apply through the parade producer. Outside the scope of a group record. Possibly relevant to an events list, not checked further.

leads_only.name: Philadelphia Thanksgiving Day Parade (6abc)
leads_only.note: Commercial broadcast parade for November 26, 2026. Bands request an application from the parade producer. Not a community group. Not checked further.

leads_only.name: The 2nd Street Festival (Northern Liberties)
leads_only.note: Festival was held August 2, 2026 and has passed. The festival's own domain did not resolve. Organizer and volunteer details not found.

leads_only.name: Neighborhood to Neighborhood (N2N) Street Festival
leads_only.note: Last dated listing found is 2016 (West Philadelphia, 50th and Baltimore). Official domain n2nfestival.com did not resolve. No 2026 date or volunteer call found.

blocked.note: Service unavailable on repeated tries, home page and volunteer page
Domain did not resolve. Block party listed only in news coverage

notes: Narrow family: 1 publishable record found in budget. Several traditions are not records for a clear reason. The Greek Independence Day Parade and Pulaski Day Parade results pointed to New York City committees (hellenicsocieties.org and pulaskiparade.org), so they were excluded for Philadelphia. The Puerto Rican Day Parade organizer domain is parked. Block Party Bonanza (city program, 250 summer block parties) ended October 3, 2026 and is a city program, not a group; not written. Mummers were excluded per brief. Searches: 8 of 10 used. Fetches: 17 used. Budget was not exhausted; further leads (Odunde, Concilio, Greek Philadelphia federation) need working domains or retries before records can be written.
